Dahi wale ALOOOO

was craving this dish that my mum serves on indian brunch sundays with puri and chole so i attempted to make it myself!

Ingredients: 
3-4 potatoes, boiled, peeled and chopped into cubes or mashed roughly
1 cup dahi + 2 tbsp besan (gram flour) + 1 cup water
1 tsp ghee
1/2 tsp jeera 
1 onion, finely chopped
1 tsp ginger paste + 1 tsp garlic paste
2 green chillies, finely chopped
a few curry leaves
1/2 tsp red chilli powder
1/2 tsp haldi
1/2 tsp coriander powder
1/2 cup water, to thin out your curd besan mix while cooking 
salt, to taste
handful of coriander leaves, to garnish

Method: 
boil, peel and chop your aloo’s you can even mash them too randomly
mix curd with besan and thin with water set aside
in a pan, add the ghee then the jeera and mix 
add in the onions, ginger garlic pastes chillies and mixxxx let the onions go nice and translucent 
add in the tomato followed by the masalas 
let this cook for 5-10 minutes till tomatoes are mushy 
add in the aloo and mix together with the masalas 
before you add in the dahi mix, either drop your flame to low or switch it off like i did then add in the dahi besan mix and stir together, restart the flame and the mix will deepen colour to a deep yellow, add in 1/2 cup water to thin out and then salt to taste 
should take 10-20 minutes you want the raw besan flavour to be gone
serve with chopped coriander | serve with rice or roti and enjoy :)
